tagline: Glowing Skin Toner – Clarify, Refresh & Brighten
intro: Achieve fresh, radiant, and balanced skin with KB Glowing Skin Toner, a gentle yet effective formula crafted to refine pores, boost hydration, and enhance your natural glow. Powered with Ceramides, Vitamin C, and Niacinamide, this toner helps strengthen the skin barrier while improving skin clarity and brightness.

Its refreshing texture removes residual impurities, tightens pores, and revitalizes tired skin, leaving it soft, smooth, and luminous. Suitable for daily use, it prepares your skin for better absorption of serums and moisturizers.

li: Tightens pores and smoothens skin texture
Improves clarity and evens skin tone

p: After cleansing, apply toner to a cotton pad or palms and gently pat onto face and neck. Use daily, morning and evening.
Perfect for daily skincare to reveal naturally glowing, healthy-looking skin

full: Glowing Skin Toner – Clarify, Refresh & Brighten
